text: In modal HoTT, a modality ◯ is called 'accessible' if it is a left Bousfield localisation. This means:
choices: It is right adjoint to inclusion
It is a nullification at a generating set of types S: ◯A = L_S A
It is idempotent on identity types
explanation: Accessible modalities are S-nullifications: modal types are those for which maps from S are constant.
